name: Elastic Security — IOC hunting
description: ES|QL queries over ECS normalised indices. Field names follow the Elastic Common Schema, so they hold for Elastic Agent, Beats and most community integrations.

match.note: Self managed Kibana runs on internal hostnames; add yours as a custom target.

templates.name: Flows involving the IP addresses
templates.description: Matches the indicator as source or destination, then collapses to one row per pair.

templates.name: DNS questions for the domains
templates.description: Which host resolved the indicators, with the answer returned.

templates.name: HTTP requests to the URLs or domains
templates.description: Proxy and web logs, matching either the full URL or the domain part.

templates.name: Files and processes matching the hashes
templates.description: ECS records the hash on both file and process documents; this covers both.

templates.name: Authentications from the IP addresses
templates.description: Splits successes from failures per account so a successful spray is obvious.
templates.body:
FROM {{var:index}}
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - {{var:range}}
| WHERE {{field}} {{op}} ({{iocs}}) AND event.category == "authentication"
| STATS attempts = COUNT(*),
        successes = COUNT(CASE(event.outcome == "success", 1, NULL)),
        failures = COUNT(CASE(event.outcome == "failure", 1, NULL))
        BY user.name, source.ip
| WHERE successes > 0
| SORT successes DESC

templates.name: Quick Lucene filter (Discover bar)
templates.description: Paste straight into the Discover query bar when you just want to eyeball the raw documents.
